instruction: A clean studio photograph with a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist white studio, three women pose playfully. On the left, the woman in the blue blazer (R1) stands facing right, smiling broadly and reaching her left hand toward the center. In the center, the woman in the lavender shirt (R2) stands in profile, laughing with her eyes closed. Behind her on the right, the woman in the green blazer (R3) hugs the woman in the lavender shirt (R2) from behind, wrapping her arm around her chest. The woman in the lavender shirt holds the hugging arm with both hands. Bright, even studio lighting illuminates the scene with soft shadows.
